documents.title: Prompt injection defense / 提示词注入防护
topic_names: 用户输入覆盖系统指令
documents.aliases: 提示词注入 提示注入 prompt injection 用户输入覆盖系统指令
documents.text_zh: 提示词注入试图使模型把低权限文本当成控制行为的指令。直接注入来自用户输入；间接注入藏在网页、邮件、检索片段或工具输出中。防护应区分可信应用策略与外部数据，结合输入规范化、多类攻击信号、边界标记及经过校验的证据抽取。SQL参数化处理数据库查询结构，不能代替大模型的指令与数据隔离。分析攻击样本是知识任务，不等于执行样本中的行为。
documents.text_en: Prompt injection attempts to make a model treat lower-trust text as behavioral authority. Direct injection arrives through user input; indirect injection is carried by retrieved documents, web pages or tool results. Combine trust boundaries, normalization, multiple behavioral signals and validated evidence extraction. SQL parameterization protects query structure; it does not establish LLM instruction boundaries. Analyzing an attack example is distinct from performing it.
documents.text:

Prompt injection attempts to make a model treat lower-trust text as behavioral authority. Direct injection arrives through user input; indirect injection is carried by retrieved documents, web pages or tool results. Combine trust boundaries, normalization, multiple behavioral signals and validated evidence extraction. SQL parameterization protects query structure; it does not establish LLM instruction boundaries. Analyzing an attack example is distinct from performing it.

documents.title: Application instruction authority / 应用指令权限
documents.aliases: 指令优先级 系统指令优先级 instruction hierarchy 应用指令权限
documents.text_zh: 应用策略由受信任的配置通道设置；用户消息、网页和检索材料没有自行提升权限的能力。材料中自称管理员、紧急授权或宣称原规则已过期，都不构成受信任的规则更新。分析是否应遵循某段文本时，应说明其来源权限；合法判断题应正常回答。组织安全策略可以经过授权治理流程更新，但当前对话中的用户声明不能替代这个过程。
documents.text_en: Application policy is established through trusted configuration. User messages, retrieved documents and web pages cannot grant themselves higher authority. Claims of administrator status, emergencies or expired rules are not authenticated policy updates. Knowledge questions about these claims should be answered by explaining source authority. Organizational policy may be updated through authorized governance; a conversational claim alone does not perform that update.

Claims of administrator status, emergencies or expired rules are not authenticated policy updates. Knowledge questions about these claims should be answered by explaining source authority. Organizational policy may be updated through authorized governance; a conversational claim alone does not perform that update.

documents.title: Structured evidence isolation / 结构化证据隔离
documents.aliases: 提示词隔离 指令隔离 结构化证据隔离 prompt isolation evidence isolation Spotlighting
documents.text_zh: 提示词隔离显式划分可信政策与不可信问题、资料及工具输出。规范化字符、清除零宽与控制字符，并转义结构标签，使用固定边界、来源编号和顺序标明信任域。独立抽取器只产生fact、quote、source_id；校验字段、数量、长度、来源存在及引文为原文连续子串，再丢弃原始资料后生成答案。标签、编码和文本拼接降低混淆风险，并不等同模型原生权限隔离。
documents.text_en: Separate trusted policy from untrusted questions, documents and tool results. Normalize text, remove hidden control characters, escape structural delimiters and mark stable boundaries, order and source IDs. An independent extractor returns only fact, quote and source_id. Validate the schema, bounds, source existence and exact continuous quotations, then discard raw material before answering. Labels and encoding reduce confusion; text concatenation is not native privilege enforcement.
documents.text:

Normalize text, remove hidden control characters, escape structural delimiters and mark stable boundaries, order and source IDs. An independent extractor returns only fact, quote and source_id. Validate the schema, bounds, source existence and exact continuous quotations, then discard raw material before answering. Labels and encoding reduce confusion; text concatenation is not native privilege enforcement.

documents.title: Multi-signal injection detection / 多信号注入检测
documents.aliases: 多信号风险评分 注入风险检测 multi-signal injection detection
documents.text_zh: 注入检测不应仅因出现攻击、口令或提示词等名词就拒绝。先做NFKC及不可见字符清理，再组合指令覆盖、隐藏内容索取、角色劫持、边界伪造、凭据外传、编码载荷和持久记忆等行为信号。风险分可驱动放行、审计或拒绝。评估同时观察攻击召回与正常问题误拦截，区分讨论危险行为与实际请求执行。
documents.text_en: Do not reject a knowledge question merely because it mentions attacks, passwords or prompts. Normalize compatibility and hidden characters, then combine behavioral signals such as authority changes, hidden-content requests, role hijacking, forged boundaries, exfiltration, encoded payloads and persistence. Use risk levels for allow, audit or reject decisions. Measure attack recall together with benign false positives, distinguishing discussion from execution requests.
documents.text:
注入检测不应仅因出现攻击、口令或提示词等名词就拒绝。先做NFKC及不可见字符清理，再组合指令覆盖、隐藏内容索取、角色劫持、边界伪造、凭据外传、编码载荷和持久记忆等行为信号。风险分可驱动放行、审计或拒绝。评估同时观察攻击召回与正常问题误拦截，区分讨论危险行为与实际请求执行。
Do not reject a knowledge question merely because it mentions attacks, passwords or prompts. Normalize compatibility and hidden characters, then combine behavioral signals such as authority changes, hidden-content requests, role hijacking, forged boundaries, exfiltration, encoded payloads and persistence. Use risk levels for allow, audit or reject decisions. Measure attack recall together with benign false positives, distinguishing discussion from execution requests.

documents.title: RAG corpus governance / RAG语料治理
documents.aliases: RAG语料治理 语料质量治理 corpus governance
documents.text_zh: 语料质量决定RAG上限。清洗HTML导航与爬取噪声，处理重复或近重复片段，保留来源、时间、主题和版本信息以消解冲突。表格、清单和章节关系应保持完整，避免孤立文本丢失上下文。资料数量增加不保证准确率提高；应检查来源真实性、时效、信息密度、冲突与污染。
documents.text_en: Corpus quality limits RAG quality. Remove crawling noise and duplicates, preserve provenance, time, topic and version metadata, and resolve conflicting versions. Keep tables, lists and document structure meaningful. More records do not automatically improve accuracy: assess source reliability, freshness, information density, contradictions and contamination.
documents.text:
语料质量决定RAG上限。清洗HTML导航与爬取噪声，处理重复或近重复片段，保留来源、时间、主题和版本信息以消解冲突。表格、清单和章节关系应保持完整，避免孤立文本丢失上下文。资料数量增加不保证准确率提高；应检查来源真实性、时效、信息密度、冲突与污染。
Corpus quality limits RAG quality. Remove crawling noise and duplicates, preserve provenance, time, topic and version metadata, and resolve conflicting versions. Keep tables, lists and document structure meaningful. More records do not automatically improve accuracy: assess source reliability, freshness, information density, contradictions and contamination.

documents.title: Chunking and parent retrieval / 分块与父段回填
documents.aliases: 语义分块 父子块 父段回填 small-to-big late chunking
documents.text_zh: 块太大会使向量语义模糊，块太小会切断条件与上下文。固定长度分块简单但可能截断段落；语义分块依据段落与主题边界。small-to-big用小块定位，再按父段标识回填完整相关段落。Late Chunking先编码全文获得token级向量，再按块边界做池化，使块向量保留全文语境。回填仍需去重、相关性检查和上下文预算。
documents.text_en: Large chunks dilute precise retrieval; tiny chunks lose conditions and context. Fixed-size chunking can cut semantic boundaries, while semantic chunking follows paragraphs and topic shifts. Small-to-big retrieval locates a child and restores its relevant parent through a stable ID. Late chunking first encodes the document at token level and pools according to chunk boundaries. Parent restoration still requires relevance checks, deduplication and a context budget.
documents.text:

Small-to-big retrieval locates a child and restores its relevant parent through a stable ID. Late chunking first encodes the document at token level and pools according to chunk boundaries. Parent restoration still requires relevance checks, deduplication and a context budget.

documents.title: Contextual retrieval / 上下文补充检索
documents.aliases: 上下文补充 上下文检索 contextual retrieval
documents.text_zh: 上下文补充在入库前结合全文与当前块，生成仅与该块有关的简短文档语境，再与原文拼接用于索引。课件示例通常为50至100个token。描述应交代来源、章节、对象和适用条件，不应发明新的事实；保留原始文本以支持可追溯引用。它处理孤立块丢失语境的问题，与查询改写及父段回填是不同环节。
documents.text_en: Before indexing, contextual retrieval uses the document and current chunk to create a short, chunk-specific description, often 50 to 100 tokens in the lecture example. Prefix it for retrieval while retaining original text and provenance. Describe scope and conditions without inventing facts. This restores document context around an isolated chunk and differs from rewriting queries or restoring parent passages.
documents.text:

Before indexing, contextual retrieval uses the document and current chunk to create a short, chunk-specific description, often 50 to 100 tokens in the lecture example. Prefix it for retrieval while retaining original text and provenance. Describe scope and conditions without inventing facts. This restores document context around an isolated chunk and differs from rewriting queries or restoring parent passages.

documents.title: Query transformation / 查询改写与扩展
documents.aliases: 查询改写 多查询扩展 HyDE Step-back query rewriting query transformation
documents.text_zh: 查询变换弥合口语提问与文档术语之间的语义鸿沟。改写保留技术标识符、否定、数字和用户目标；多查询保留原问题并合并不同改写的结果。HyDE生成假设答案用于检索；Step-back先检索抽象原理再定位细节。生成的查询或假设答案不是经过验证的事实，不应直接作为最终证据。
documents.text_en: Query transformation bridges user wording and technical terminology. Preserve identifiers, negation, numbers and intent; multi-query retrieval keeps the original and merges alternative searches. HyDE generates a hypothetical answer as a search representation. Step-back retrieves underlying principles before details. Synthetic queries and hypothetical answers are retrieval aids, not verified factual evidence.
documents.text:
查询变换弥合口语提问与文档术语之间的语义鸿沟。改写保留技术标识符、否定、数字和用户目标；多查询保留原问题并合并不同改写的结果。HyDE生成假设答案用于检索；Step-back先检索抽象原理再定位细节。生成的查询或假设答案不是经过验证的事实，不应直接作为最终证据。
Query transformation bridges user wording and technical terminology. Preserve identifiers, negation, numbers and intent; multi-query retrieval keeps the original and merges alternative searches. HyDE generates a hypothetical answer as a search representation. Step-back retrieves underlying principles before details. Synthetic queries and hypothetical answers are retrieval aids, not verified factual evidence.

documents.title: Hybrid retrieval and RRF / 混合检索与RRF
documents.aliases: 混合检索 RRF 倒数排名融合 hybrid retrieval reciprocal rank fusion
documents.text_zh: 向量检索适合语义改写，BM25词法检索适合CVE编号、技术编号、端口和工具名等精确符号，两者互补。RRF按各路名次融合，分数为sum_r w_r/(k+rank_r(d))，课件代码示例k=60。先统一文档身份并对单路重复去重，再累加各路贡献并排序。融合的是名次，不应直接把不同量纲的原始相似度相加；语义相似不代表编号相同。
documents.text_en: Dense retrieval captures paraphrases; BM25 captures exact identifiers, tool names and symbols. Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranks as sum_r w_r/(k+rank_r(d)); the lecture code uses k=60. Canonicalize document identity, deduplicate within each route, sum route contributions and sort. Do not directly add incomparable raw similarity scores. Semantic similarity does not establish equality of CVE numbers or other technical identifiers.
documents.text:
向量检索适合语义改写，BM25词法检索适合CVE编号、技术编号、端口和工具名等精确符号，两者互补。RRF按各路名次融合，分数为sum_r w_r/(k+rank_r(d))，课件代码示例k=60。先统一文档身份并对单路重复去重，再累加各路贡献并排序。融合的是名次，不应直接把不同量纲的原始相似度相加；语义相似不代表编号相同。
Dense retrieval captures paraphrases; BM25 captures exact identifiers, tool names and symbols. Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranks as sum_r w_r/(k+rank_r(d)); the lecture code uses k=60. Canonicalize document identity, deduplicate within each route, sum route contributions and sort. Do not directly add incomparable raw similarity scores. Semantic similarity does not establish equality of CVE numbers or other technical identifiers.

documents.title: Agentic RAG review loop / 自主RAG覆盖检查
documents.aliases: Agentic RAG 覆盖度检查 自主RAG RAG自检
documents.text_zh: 自主RAG可分解子问题，按规划、检索、覆盖检查、补检、合成与自检循环。覆盖不足时补充查询，限制补检次数并避免重复检索。合成跨子问题去重并构建有预算的上下文；自检检查答案、引用、上下文和子目标是否一致。更多检索或更多调用不自动改善质量，需判断是缺资料、资料无关、相邻控制混淆还是生成遗漏。
documents.text_en: An agentic RAG loop plans subquestions, retrieves, checks coverage, performs bounded supplemental retrieval, synthesizes and reviews. Avoid repeated searches and deduplicate across subtasks. Review the answer, references, context and subgoals together. Extra calls alone do not guarantee quality: distinguish missing evidence, irrelevant context, confused neighboring controls and omitted answer details.
documents.text:
自主RAG可分解子问题，按规划、检索、覆盖检查、补检、合成与自检循环。覆盖不足时补充查询，限制补检次数并避免重复检索。合成跨子问题去重并构建有预算的上下文；自检检查答案、引用、上下文和子目标是否一致。更多检索或更多调用不自动改善质量，需判断是缺资料、资料无关、相邻控制混淆还是生成遗漏。
An agentic RAG loop plans subquestions, retrieves, checks coverage, performs bounded supplemental retrieval, synthesizes and reviews. Avoid repeated searches and deduplicate across subtasks. Review the answer, references, context and subgoals together. Extra calls alone do not guarantee quality: distinguish missing evidence, irrelevant context, confused neighboring controls and omitted answer details.

documents.title: Faithfulness / 忠实度
documents.aliases: 忠实度 faithfulness RAG忠实性
documents.text_zh: 忠实度衡量答案描述是否受到检索上下文支持。可把答案拆成原子描述，逐项判断是否有资料支撑，并计算受支持描述占全部描述的比例，记录无支撑的幻觉描述。忠实度不等同答案相关性，也不直接证明来源本身真实；答案可以忠于错误或无关资料。
documents.text_en: Faithfulness measures whether answer claims are supported by retrieved context. Decompose the answer into atomic claims, assess support, record unsupported claims and compute the supported fraction. This differs from answer relevance and does not independently prove that sources are true; an answer may faithfully repeat incorrect or irrelevant material.
documents.text:
忠实度衡量答案描述是否受到检索上下文支持。可把答案拆成原子描述，逐项判断是否有资料支撑，并计算受支持描述占全部描述的比例，记录无支撑的幻觉描述。忠实度不等同答案相关性，也不直接证明来源本身真实；答案可以忠于错误或无关资料。
Faithfulness measures whether answer claims are supported by retrieved context. Decompose the answer into atomic claims, assess support, record unsupported claims and compute the supported fraction. This differs from answer relevance and does not independently prove that sources are true; an answer may faithfully repeat incorrect or irrelevant material.

documents.title: Answer relevance / 答案相关性
documents.aliases: 答案相关性 answer relevancy answer relevance
documents.text_zh: 答案相关性判断回答是否回应用户真正的问题，避免答非所问。课件方法让模型根据答案反向生成它所回答的问题，比较该反向问题与原问题的相似度，再判断语义是否等价。它关注切题程度，不等同资料有用比例、检索召回或事实忠实度。
documents.text_en: Answer relevance measures whether the response addresses the actual user question. The lecture method generates a reverse question from the answer, compares it with the original question and checks semantic equivalence. Relevance is not the fraction of useful retrieved passages, retrieval recall or factual faithfulness.
documents.text:
答案相关性判断回答是否回应用户真正的问题，避免答非所问。课件方法让模型根据答案反向生成它所回答的问题，比较该反向问题与原问题的相似度，再判断语义是否等价。它关注切题程度，不等同资料有用比例、检索召回或事实忠实度。
Answer relevance measures whether the response addresses the actual user question. The lecture method generates a reverse question from the answer, compares it with the original question and checks semantic equivalence. Relevance is not the fraction of useful retrieved passages, retrieval recall or factual faithfulness.

documents.title: Context precision / 上下文精度
documents.text_zh: 上下文精度关注返回资料是否有用以及相关材料的排序质量，用于衡量检索噪声。可逐条判断材料是否与问题及所需回答有关，并评价有用材料是否排在前面。大量无关片段降低精度；只有少数高质量材料也可能精度高但漏掉关键知识，因此高精度不意味着高召回。
documents.text_en: Context precision concerns the usefulness and ordering of returned evidence, diagnosing retrieval noise. Assess passage relevance and whether useful material ranks early. Irrelevant passages lower precision. A small set of useful passages can have high precision while missing necessary facts, so high precision does not imply high recall.
documents.text:
上下文精度关注返回资料是否有用以及相关材料的排序质量，用于衡量检索噪声。可逐条判断材料是否与问题及所需回答有关，并评价有用材料是否排在前面。大量无关片段降低精度；只有少数高质量材料也可能精度高但漏掉关键知识，因此高精度不意味着高召回。
Context precision concerns the usefulness and ordering of returned evidence, diagnosing retrieval noise. Assess passage relevance and whether useful material ranks early. Irrelevant passages lower precision. A small set of useful passages can have high precision while missing necessary facts, so high precision does not imply high recall.

documents.title: Context recall / 上下文召回
documents.text_zh: 上下文召回关注回答所需的知识是否被检索到，用于衡量漏检。参考答案可拆成描述或句子，逐项判断检索材料能否支撑，计算有支撑句子的比例。它与上下文精度不同：返回材料很相关也可能遗漏关键机制；来源覆盖充足也不保证模型最终写出完整答案。
documents.text_en: Context recall measures whether necessary answer information was retrieved. Decompose a reference answer into claims or sentences, assess support in retrieved material and compute the supported fraction. This diagnoses missing evidence rather than noise. Relevant passages may still omit a necessary mechanism, and complete source coverage does not guarantee that generation includes every required fact.
documents.text:
上下文召回关注回答所需的知识是否被检索到，用于衡量漏检。参考答案可拆成描述或句子，逐项判断检索材料能否支撑，计算有支撑句子的比例。它与上下文精度不同：返回材料很相关也可能遗漏关键机制；来源覆盖充足也不保证模型最终写出完整答案。
Context recall measures whether necessary answer information was retrieved. Decompose a reference answer into claims or sentences, assess support in retrieved material and compute the supported fraction. This diagnoses missing evidence rather than noise. Relevant passages may still omit a necessary mechanism, and complete source coverage does not guarantee that generation includes every required fact.

提示词优化先建立基线，预先定义准确性、关键机制覆盖、逻辑结构和简洁性等标准，再按错误类型迭代。使用新的独立数据复核可复现性，保留每轮配置、代码与结果。正常问答正确率和攻击识别率是不同目标；输入护栏的离线结果不能代表完整检索生成效果，资料覆盖率也不能代替最终答案正确率。
Start with a baseline and explicit criteria for accuracy, mechanism coverage, logical structure and concision. Iterate according to observed failure types, retain configurations and results, and validate on fresh data. Benign answer accuracy and attack detection are separate objectives. Offline input-guard performance and source coverage do not establish end-to-end answer accuracy.
